keyword: theoretical concrete pump output when ordering

title.en: Treat Xingtai’s m³/h Cell as Catalogue Output When You Order
title.zh: 下单时把邢台的 m³/h 格子当作目录输送量

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints theoretical output or output capacity. That cell is what you compare. It is not labelled as a guaranteed site total, and it is not the numeral in the model name.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印的是理论输送量或输出能力。采购对照的是这一格。它没有被标成工地保证总量，也不是型号名称里的数字。

h1.en: Order from the Printed m³/h Cell
h1.zh: 按印出的 m³/h 格子下单

directAnswer.en: When you order from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, copy the output words on the page. Electric 20 says 8–10 m³/h. Diesel 50 says 30 m³/h. LZ-80 says high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Those marks, including the range and the “≤”, stay in the inquiry. The pages do not add a second line called guaranteed site output. Your own required output is a separate sentence.
directAnswer.zh: 向河北品锦机械（邢台）下单时，抄页面上的输送量原文。电动20写 8–10 m³/h。柴油50写 30 m³/h。LZ-80 写高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。区间和“≤”都留在询盘里。这些页面没有另加一行叫工地保证产量。你自己需要的输送量另写一句。

body.en: Write “page prints 21 m³/h” and “we need to discuss our required output” as different clauses. Electric 40’s printed output is 21 m³/h. Do not replace it with the 40 in the name.
body.zh: 把“页面印 21 m³/h”和“我们需要讨论的目标输送量”写成不同的分句。电动40印出的输送量是 21 m³/h。不要用名称里的 40 替换它。

body.en: LZ-80’s two output figures belong to high-pressure and low-pressure modes on that diesel page. Ordering “95 m³/h” without the low-pressure label drops half the cell. Delivery height on that page is “consult factory standard”, not a metres figure.
body.zh: LZ-80 的两个输送量属于该柴油页上的高压和低压模式。只写“95 m³/h”而不写低压，会丢掉半格。该页输送高度是“咨询工厂标准”，不是一个米数。

body.en: [/en/contact/](/en/contact/), with the slug. Hebei Pinjin Machinery confirms whether the printed cell is the one to quote. It does not confirm a price on this article.
body.zh: 连同型号地址发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。河北品锦机械确认要报价的是不是这一印出的格子。本篇不确认价格。

answer.en: It is the printed range on Electric 15 and Electric 20. Keep both ends.
answer.zh: 它是电动15和电动20上印出的区间。两端都保留。

question.en: Can I average two rows into one output?
question.zh: 可以把两行距离平均成一个输送量吗？

answer.en: No. Output and distance are different cells.
answer.zh: 不能。输送量和距离是不同的格子。

question.en: Who says if our needed rate fits?
question.zh: 谁说明我们需要的产量是否合适？

answer.en: Xingtai, after the inquiry. Not a marketplace average.
answer.zh: 邢台，在询盘之后。不是平台上的平均数字。
